articles.title: Qualcomm CEO: Its Data Center Ramp Is “All Supply Bound,” Not Demand Bound
articles.description: Key TakeawaysQualcomm stock fell about 11% this week after its earnings guidance for the December quarter came in below expectations. CEO Cristiano Amon says supply is the only thing limiting the company’s $5 billion data center revenue target for fiscal 2027.

articles.title: Qualcomm Rises 5% on Alphabet’s $548 Million Stake as CEO Sees a “Disconnect” on AI
articles.description: Key TakeawaysQualcomm shares rose 5% today on Alphabet’s nearly $548 million stake. The stake backs Qualcomm’s data center push, still targeting $5 billion of revenue in fiscal 2027.
